description: Angular component class for configuring analogue gauge widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, default settings, validation, and output preparation.

classes.name: AnalogueGaugeWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing analogue gauge widget settings, including form initialization, default values, validation logic, and output settings processing.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the analogue gauge widget.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current settings values.

methods.name: prepareOutputSettings
methods.description: Prepares and returns the settings object for output, applying form values.
